I was talking with someone recently and they casually mentioned that gyroscope/accelerometer navigation is very accurate. I said that there must be a non-significant amount of creep that would increase with maneuvering. He said, how do the Mars rovers navigate so well then?! I had no idea.

I'm assuming they use some form of dead reckoning that could be calibrated occasionally with satellites imagery or some type of GPS?? Or perhaps the sun could be used as a reference point? I think I heard that there is no magnetic poles, so no compass. So maybe it is just gyroscopes or accelerometers?
How do the Mars rovers navigate and keep orientation accurately?

I think the rovers rely mostly on cameras and detailed maps to navigate:

JPL

The linked article explains using stereo imagery for obstacle avoidance and path finding. This is really interesting, but it sounds like this is an immediate or short distance solution.

I'm really curious as to how it keeps accurate distance and heading over longer distances. For example after travelling for a long distance how does it know it hasn't crept a degree or two to the left? How does it know it's travelled 1.0km, not 0.95km?

When I was 18 my mother died, my sister was working away from home and my father simply wasn't there.

I fell into depression, very very profound depression. For years I lived day after day doing the absolute minimum I could get away with (and very often less).

I lived my life in the sofa, with the TV always on and browsing the internet aimlessly... While there I lost my friends and most of all I lost life.

I remember I tried with all of my might to get up, to change things but it just didn't work.

I lost all hope... I was just waiting for the days to end.

In the middle of all this I just don't know how I got an oportunity to go back to finish college... I don't know how but I did, and put all of my effort into that. I met nice people with whom I could socialize while there... I finished college... I married someone I met there... Got a masters.. and now have a completely unrelated job that makes me happy...

Today we are throwing away the old sofa where I lived for six years and putting a brand new unsweated one. I'm not depressed anymore. I'm really content, even happy.

I'm not saying it will get better but to keep trying, someday it will work.
Thanks :) I will for sure, happiest time of my life :)
